inputs: 250 frames from first to last event, sum contiguous groups of 5 cochlear channels; the upstream SSC loader reads pre-binned files and does not specify raw time binning
theta_choice: Table 4; explicitly overrides the SSC training script default of 250; exact setting of the 72.90 run unverified
recognition: All 200 epochs on clean data, no augmentation, Adam lr=0.01, StepLR(80,0.5), no weight decay or gradient clipping, CE on mean logits over all 250 frames, no active dropout
selection: Highest whole-word validation accuracy checked every epoch; earliest tie; strict split isolation
test: Official test. Clean and whole-event additive Poisson .0625/.125/.25 read at event end by mean logits; appended Poisson .25 L80 read on last 20. Full and bias-preserving dynamic-memory ablation; additionally stable-only read ablation for GDSM.
sharing: Equal examples, shuffle, corruption, backbone initialization, optimizer, updates, scoring and selection per phase across families; GDSM uses extra stable state and gate parameters. Known boundaries; single training seed.
earlier_results: The older 40+12 baseline with max pooling and batch 512 answers a different training question and is not an author-performance replication.
comparison: Only Adam starting learning rate changes from the prior 256-wide clean fit; all training and validation selection settings match.
